Only current HTTP /{index}/ingest v2 and initial indexing ingestion plumbing. Source actor, Source assignment/emit/receive wait and Source statuses, indexing actors, Publisher/metastore publication operation, pipeline supervisor, merge, legacy v1, Elasticsearch bulk front-end and external connectors excluded. Post-Source-dispatch detached truncate task and positions-service plumbing included.

Generic runtime runnable/executing/completed/cancelled/failed, blocking/Rayon job scheduling, actor mailboxes/dispatch/lifecycle and timers are provided by common actor audit, not counted here. running and ready are declared shared anchors; generic ready->running dispatch edges intentionally omitted. Pending dependency edges are conditional; immediate-ready execution stays in running without a fabricated state.

Each graph is one owner-qualified local dimension. No global combinations, per-document/byte/position enumerations, arbitrary retry-counter values, per-shard multiplicity, or elapsed-time ticks. Numeric values are retained as transition guards/parameters and threshold classes where actions differ. Counts are an inventory, not an exhaustive finite-state quotient proof.

Edges include explicit application updates/ownership transfers and Pending enter/completion boundaries. Guards of same operation and ownership are grouped in one trigger. Different application triggers can share endpoints. Pure ignored/no-op branches excluded except the explicit named CP debouncer Emit transition. Generic task shutdown/error edges are not copied into every graph.

Intrinsic DB transactions, S3, OS/filesystem/TCP/HTTP2, serializer/framing internals and Chitchat protocol excluded. WAL wrapper ownership and production flush-policy gate included. Prior audit documents buffered append, in-memory visibility, IO partial effects, replay and file-reference GC, but no speculative physical durability state machine counted here.

WAL physical file pin/unpin/rolling/GC and replay record-level transitions remain uncounted implementation detail. Truncate/delete blocking jobs execute synchronous GC; there is no separate WAL GC task or periodic five-second flush worker. Exact recovery IO-error branch behavior and physical writer buffer states require separate pinned-library ledger if expanded.

Ingester instantaneous per-shard rate-token admission and estimated disk/memory capacity predicates are documented in persist graph but their numeric data stores are not exhaustively counted. Mapper cache, metrics/gauges, debug endpoints and event slow-warning diagnostic task internals are omitted.

Router node eligibility (generation equality, pool membership/Ready, capacity>0, count>0, unavailable set, AZ preference), CP placement least-load selection, zonal balancing, scaling thresholds and synchronous physical-plan algorithm internals are predicates/data transformations, not invented per-function phases. Broad node-pool/gossip protocol lifecycle excluded.

Administrative CP index/source CRUD, prune-shard cooldown and metastore consistency supervisor mechanics excluded beyond startup ingest-source migration and ingest-driven auto-create. CP local Unavailable enum/imported legacy branches not evidenced as current ingest mutation states and omitted.

RebuildNotifier future supports waiting but production CP callers at this HEAD drop all returned waiter futures. No plan-ack barrier, distributed consensus, replica WAL acknowledgment, lease, fencing worker or serial handoff mechanism invented.

EventBroker subscription-lock mechanics included once here. If common actor ledger also covers EventBroker, deduplicate wal_event_delivery_dependency at integration. Fetch queue ownership graphs cover concrete buffers, not generic channel occupancy automata.
counting_rule: Count graph-local states excluding shared_states. Count distinct (from,to) edges with from != to; alternative triggers and unchanged-state retries do not add edges. Shared runtime counted once per design, actor framework once for current only. No global products or execution counts.
